description: Bounded selected-source acquisition and immutable offline replay for PA DHS listed Child Care Centers; normalization and managed app enrollment are separate.
redirect_policy: Reject all redirects. Fixed ajn5-kaxt SODA2 endpoints and portal policy only; no alternate hosts or credential fallback.
retry: No automatic retries. HTTP errors and publisher deferral stop the attempt without acquiring replacement data or falling back to another API.
checkpoint: Await durable prerequisite retention before membership requests; await each validated observation's journal before the next request. Save complete verified acquisition before any downstream normalization.
idempotency: Immutable UUID-scoped acquisition. Never overwrite or repull a retained release for offline verification or promotion. Interrupted partial acquisition is inspectable, not automatically resumable.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation through requests, pacing, replay and precommit persistence. Only owned incomplete cancellation artifacts may be cleaned; preserve uncertain postcommit evidence for inspection.
retention_profile: Internal selected facility source data and complete accompanying notices; raw catalog contact caches are never retained.
